welcome.title: Welcome to Bernardo's English Helper!
welcome.body: This is your safe and friendly space to practice speaking English. You will talk with an AI assistant — it is patient, friendly, and always ready to chat.

tour.topicsBody: Tap the Starters tab to pick a topic — daily life, travel, food, and more. It gives you something to talk about right away.
tour.micBody: Tap the big green button and start speaking. The assistant listens and replies in English. Take your time — no rush.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.step2: Press the big green microphone button
howItWorks.step3: Speak in English — the assistant will reply!

micTip.title: One small tip before we start
micTip.body: For the best experience, make sure your surroundings are quiet and your microphone is working.
micTip.tip1: Use headphones if you have them
micTip.tip2: Find a quiet room with little background noise

ready.title: You are all set!
ready.body: Press the button below to start your first English conversation. Take your time — there is no rush.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1title: 1. Who is responsible for this study?
privacy.s1p1: This application is used as part of a PhD research project conducted by:
privacy.s1p2: The study has been reviewed and approved by the UCM Ethics Committee (Comité de Ética de la Investigación) under reference
privacy.s2intro: We collect only the information needed for the research:
privacy.s2item1: your first name, surname, age, country, native language, and English level. You provide this when you register.
privacy.s2item2: the text and audio of your English practice sessions with the AI assistant.
privacy.s2item3: when you use the app, how long each session lasts, and which topics you practise.
privacy.s2item4: your email address (used only for account access) and account creation date.
privacy.s2note: We do not collect payment information, location data, or any sensitive personal data beyond what is listed above.
privacy.s3title: 3. Why do we collect this data?
privacy.s3intro: Your data is used solely for:
privacy.s3item1: Providing you with personalised English practice through the AI assistant.
privacy.s3item2: Academic research into how adults aged 50 and over learn English with AI tools (PhD thesis at UCM).
privacy.s3item3: Tracking your own learning progress within the app.
privacy.s3note: Your data will never be sold, shared for commercial purposes, or used for advertising.
privacy.s4intro: Your data is processed by two external services:
privacy.s4supabase: Stores your account information, profile, and conversation history in a secure database. Supabase is compliant with GDPR and processes data under Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacy.s4openai: Processes your voice audio in real-time to power the AI conversation assistant. Audio is sent to OpenAI's API and is not stored by OpenAI for training purposes under the API usage terms.
privacy.s4note: No other third parties receive your personal data.
privacy.s5title: 5. How long do we keep your data?
privacy.s5p1: Your data will be kept for a maximum of 5 years from the date your account is created, as required by the UCM Ethics Committee approval.
privacy.s5p2: After that period, all personal data will be permanently deleted or anonymised so it can no longer be linked to you.
privacy.s5p3: You can also request deletion of your data at any time — see Section 6 below.
privacy.s6intro: Under EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD), you have the following rights:
privacy.s6r1: you can ask us to send you a copy of all the data we hold about you. Use the "Download My Data" button in your account settings.
privacy.s6r2: you can correct any inaccurate information in your profile at any time via account settings.
privacy.s6r3title: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
privacy.s6r3: you can permanently delete your account and all associated data. Use the "Delete My Account & Data" button in your account settings.
privacy.s6r4: you can download your data in a machine-readable format (JSON) using the "Download My Data" button.
privacy.s6r5: you can object to the processing of your data for research purposes at any time by contacting us at
privacy.s6r6: you gave your consent when you registered. You can withdraw it at any time by deleting your account, with no negative consequences.
privacy.s6contact: To exercise any of these rights, you can use the in-app tools in your account settings, or contact us directly:
privacy.s6aepd: If you believe your data protection rights have not been respected, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Authority (AEPD — www.aepd.es).
privacy.s7p1: The legal basis for processing your personal data is your informed and freely given consent, provided when you registered for this study (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR, and Article 9(2)(a) for any research-related data).
privacy.s7p2: Processing for scientific research purposes is additionally supported by Article 89 GDPR and Spanish Law 3/2018.
privacy.s8p1: Your data is stored in a password-protected, encrypted Supabase database. Access is restricted to the researcher and the database administrator. All connections use HTTPS encryption.
privacy.s9p1: If we need to make significant changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you by email and ask for your consent again if required.
privacy.footerLaw: Governed by EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).
